A '''gription seam''' used [[gription]] technology to close heavy-duty bags and other containers whenever there was the possibility of spillage or contamination. Gription seams were used on body bags and waste containers, to prevent any form of transfer of viruses or other harmful agents.

After her death, [[Ailyn Vel]] was put in a body bag closed by a gription seam.<ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref>
